label: PF Backlog 601
title: EDP-20: Append-only AuditStore; split orchestrator/storage.py (audit vs cache vs evidence); retention/redaction; large checkpoints -> object store

brief.problem: Audit, cache, and evidence paths are tangled in storage.py with no tamper-evident audit store
brief.what_adds: Append-only AuditStore, clean module split, retention/redaction, checkpoint offload
brief.why: Compliance, maintainability, and storage cost control
brief.who_feels: Auditors, orchestrator maintainers, and storage operators

objective: EDP-20 slice 1: partition audit by RANGE(at) with a safe swap + managed partition/retention lifecycle (no lost audit events).
acceptance_criteria: AuditStore DAO enforces append-only (no update/delete at app layer)
storage.py split into audit/cache/evidence modules with no behavior regression
Checkpoints over threshold stored in ObjectStore with manifest reference
in_scope: explicit view recreate (no CASCADE) + UTC bounds + grace partition
approach: 0014 runs as pf_owner (BYPASSRLS). Order: (1) rename audit->audit_legacy; (2) CREATE TABLE audit(...) PARTITION BY RANGE(at), PK(id,at); (3) create monthly partitions spanning legacy min/max + current+next 3 months (UTC); (4) COPY legacy rows while NO RLS/triggers exist yet; (5) THEN ENABLE+FORCE RLS tenant_isolation + create append-only trigger; (6) setval new sequence from legacy max(id) for id continuity; (7) recreate views explicitly and DROP audit_legacy (no CASCADE). A short write-freeze maintenance window guarantees no lost events during the swap. Partition provisioning: audit_ensure_partitions(through_month) invoked by a SCHEDULED job (outbox/scheduler) >=3 months ahead + coverage check+alert; grace/overflow partition for late writes. Retention: audit_apply_retention(keep_months) SCHEDULED; keep_months from CONFIG (PF_AUDIT_RETENTION_MONTHS default 13); respects legal holds; NOT granted to app/tenant roles. Observability: metrics for coverage horizon, retention outcome, insert failures. Down: structural rollback only; retention-dropped data unrecoverable (acknowledged).
verification: DONE (slice): ingest-time audit REDACTION in AuditStore.Append (emails/secrets masked before write; append-only preserved) - PR #236; tests pass
FINDING (recorded): retention CANNOT be row DELETE/UPDATE (deny_mutation trigger); use time-PARTITIONING + partition drop; redaction is at ingest
REMAINING EDP-20: audit partitioning+retention; Python AgentAuditLog -> /audit fail-closed client; storage.py MOVE-split; large checkpoints -> object store
SEPARATE (BI-PF-1425): migrate cache + evidence/summarizer to Go
rollback: structural rollback; retention-dropped data is unrecoverable
evidence: Existing audit modules and evidence endpoints

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/audit.py and core/audit_trail.py into an append-only AuditStore (hash-chained, tamper-evident); refactor orchestrator/storage.py to split audit vs cache vs evidence paths; route large checkpoints to the ObjectStore from BI-PF-1308/1306 with retention/redaction rules.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-1308 (object store retention) at done for checkpoint offload
conflict_findings: orchestrator/storage.py is a hot module — concurrent edits by any storage item must be serialized
Overlap with evidence APIs owned by release/CI paths
duplication_findings: core/audit.py and core/audit_trail.py already exist — extend, do not rewrite
core/tool_cache.py is separate cache path — split keeps it distinct from audit
Evidence APIs (/api/v1/evidence/*) already exist — reuse as evidence branch
analysis.rationale: Existing audit modules and evidence APIs provide strong reuse; work is primarily an extension plus a targeted refactor of storage.py with clear boundaries.
assumptions: Append-only enforced at DAO level (no UPDATE/DELETE), retention via partition drop
Redaction is field-level and applied at read time or via tombstone entries
risks: Append-only store growth without retention causes cost blowup
Redaction must not break audit chain integrity
Refactor of storage.py risks behavioral regression in orchestrator
Large checkpoint offload latency on hot path
evidence: Existing audit modules and evidence endpoints
missing_info: Redaction policy (which fields, GDPR vs internal)
